rom_purpose.current_question: purpose-specific state-count sufficiency and closure attribution
rom_purpose.reason: P3 freezes purpose-specific vertical representation ladders for surface-propagation and lower-boundary groundwater response. It does not define a root-uptake/root-stress structural-error tolerance or application acceptance envelope.

rationale: ROM-ROOT already establishes that exact forcing-portable root feedback requires threshold-queryable root-weighted pressure-head distribution information or an equivalent object.
ROM-PURPOSE P3 is scientifically relevant to vertical placement and state-count sufficiency, but its current SURF_P/GW_LB contract does not provide the missing root-feedback acceptance authority.
ROM-ACCEPT has not changed and still provides no matching quantitative root-feedback structural-error budget.
Opening a finite approximate root descriptor now would create a selection problem without an independently frozen criterion for sufficiency.
reopen_conditions: An independent purpose owner freezes a root-feedback/profile structural-error budget, including temporal and spatial semantics.
ROM-PURPOSE later closes an explicit root-feedback purpose contract that requires an approximation frontier independent of application acceptance.
A separately scoped approximation-theory study is explicitly authorized with no sufficiency or application-admission claim.
